text:
Lauren: Quick ask — prepping the webinar next week. Need a small deliverable set for promotion and deck: 1) 16:9 hero slide + thumbnail, 2) three compact benchmark cards for socials/slides, 3) ops one-pager with lead-routing snippet. Brand-safe + accessible. Deadline: EOD Tue (48h). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/bench-webinar (placeholder)
Ashwin: Got it. Can you confirm final headline copy, primary metric, and exact sizes? e.g. thumbnail 1200x628, slide 1920x1080?
Lauren: Headline (working): "Serving wins: inference economics at scale" — flexible. Primary metrics: tokens/sec and $/1k tokens. Thumbs: 1200x628 ok for socials. Also need an 800x800 promo tile.
Maria: quick legal note — no customer logos unless we have sign-off. Brand hexes: primary #0A2F4A, accent #2FBF71. Accessibility: aim for WCAG AA contrast.
Ben: Growth ask — include UTM template for CTA links: `?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=serving_wins&utm_medium=slide_cta`. Also include hidden form field `campaign=serving_wins` so inbound tags to SDR queue.
Ashwin: Plan: I'll do one hero comp + three card variants (stat, sparkline, quote). Will drop initial frames in Figma by noon tomorrow. Imagery prefs? abstract infra + 1 product screenshot?
Lauren: Abstract infra + one product screenshot works. Also want a tiny "how we measure" callout box for cost numbers (small badge on cards).
design-bot: Checklist generated ✅: deliverables: [hero slide, thumbnail, 3 card variants, ops one-pager]. Sizes: [1920x1080, 1200x628, 800x800]. Exports: png/jpg/svg. Accessibility: contrast check. Naming conv: use `YYYYMMDD_webinar_<asset>_v1.ext` e.g. `20250312_webinar_hero_v1.fig`.
Ashwin: Quick Q — underscores or dashes in filenames? I'll follow bot but want to be consistent.
Lauren: Underscores are fine. Also please tag assets in Figma with `launch:serving-wins` and leave a comment for @legal when comps ready. :thumbsup:
Maria: I'll upload approved speaker headshots to the Figma file and flag legal for a pass once comps are up. :eyes:
Ben: Once assets live, I'll wire the CTA to the landing page and confirm tracking. Thanks team.
Ashwin: Ok will post first pass tomorrow noon. If anyone has last-minute copy tweaks drop them in the Figma comments.
Lauren: Thanks — really appreciate the fast turn.
